area.label: Land area
area.definition: Land area excluding inland water bodies. National statistical boundaries may differ from the simplified outline.

life.label: Life expectancy
life.definition: Life expectancy at birth, both sexes. A period estimate based on current mortality rates.

happiness.label: Life satisfaction
happiness.definition: Average self-reported life evaluation on a 0–10 ladder, over three years ending 2025. Survey estimates, not an objective measure of happiness.

density.label: Population density
density.definition: Total population divided by land area, both 2023. National averages mask where people actually live.

forest.label: Forest cover
forest.definition: Forest area as a percentage of land area.

renewable.label: Renewable electricity
renewable.definition: Share of electricity output from renewable sources. This is electricity, not all energy use. Latest common usable snapshot from this World Bank series is 2021.

internet.label: Internet use
internet.definition: Individuals using the internet, as a percentage of total population.

gdp.label: GDP per person (PPP)
gdp.definition: GDP per capita adjusted for purchasing-power differences, current international dollars. Not household income or wealth.

patents.label: Resident patent applications
patents.definition: Resident patent applications divided by same-year population, multiplied by one million. Applications, not granted patents. Original source WIPO.

alcohol.label: Alcohol consumption
alcohol.unit: L pure alcohol / person aged 15+ / year
alcohol.definition: Total estimated annual alcohol consumption per resident aged 15+, including abstainers; litres of pure alcohol, not litres of beer or wine. WHO data distributed by World Bank.

co2.label: CO₂ per person
co2.source: Global Carbon Budget via Our World in Data
co2.definition: Annual territorial CO₂ emissions from fossil fuels and industry per person. Excludes land-use change and is not consumption-based emissions.

hdi.label: Human Development Index
hdi.source: UNDP via Our World in Data
hdi.definition: UNDP composite index covering life expectancy, education and income. Scores range from 0 to 1; an index is not a physical quantity.

calories.label: Food energy supply
calories.source: FAOSTAT via Our World in Data
calories.definition: Food energy available per person per day. Supply includes food that may be wasted; this is not actual calorie intake.

cattle.label: Cattle per person
cattle.source: FAOSTAT via Our World in Data · derived
cattle.definition: Cattle stocks divided by the same-year 2023 population. Cattle includes more than dairy cows; stocks are recorded at national reference dates.

doctorates.label: Doctorate attainment
doctorates.definition: Share of adults aged 25–64 whose attainment is doctoral or equivalent level (ISCED 2011 level 8), both sexes combined. Same calendar year 2024. Normal-value observations only; missing or included-in-another-category cells excluded. Not the percentage of the entire population and not annual PhD graduates. OECD source display precision is one decimal place. Compare/rank/insert questions require reported standard errors and nonoverlapping approximate 95% intervals (estimate ±1.96 standard errors). Missing uncertainty is excluded from those comparisons; this is a conservative gameplay guard, not a formal statistical test.

mobileTraffic.label: Mobile internet traffic
mobileTraffic.source: ITU DataHub via World Bank · population: World Bank
mobileTraffic.definition: Annual domestic mobile-broadband Internet traffic (3G or newer), uploads and downloads combined, divided by the same country’s 2024 midyear population. Exabytes converted to decimal gigabytes (1 EB = 1 billion GB). This is GB per resident per YEAR, not per subscriber or per month, and includes business traffic. Missing traffic or population observations excluded.
mobileTraffic.license: CC BY 4.0 per World Bank catalog; traffic originally ITU, denominator World Bank SP.POP.TOTL.

fixedTraffic.label: Fixed internet traffic
fixedTraffic.source: ITU DataHub via World Bank · population: World Bank
fixedTraffic.definition: Annual fixed-broadband Internet traffic, uploads and downloads combined, divided by the same country’s 2024 midyear population. Exabytes converted to decimal gigabytes (1 EB = 1 billion GB). This is GB per resident per YEAR, not per subscriber or per month, and includes business traffic. Missing traffic or population observations excluded.
fixedTraffic.license: CC BY 4.0 per World Bank catalog; traffic originally ITU, denominator World Bank SP.POP.TOTL.

internetTraffic.label: Total broadband internet traffic
internetTraffic.source: ITU DataHub via World Bank · population: World Bank
internetTraffic.definition: Sum of reported fixed and mobile broadband Internet traffic in 2024 (uploads plus downloads), divided by 2024 midyear population. GB per resident per YEAR, not a typical user’s personal consumption. Only countries reporting BOTH fixed and mobile components are included. No missing component is filled with zero. Decimal conversion: 1 EB = 1 billion GB.
internetTraffic.license: CC BY 4.0 per World Bank catalog.

heightMale.label: Male height at age 18
heightMale.source: NCD-RisC (eLife 2016), processed by Our World in Data
heightMale.definition: Modelled national mean height at age 18 for people born in 1996, separately by sex. These are historical cohort estimates from the 2016 NCD-RisC study, NOT current all-adult height or age19 in2019. OWID export supplies point estimates, not uncertainty bounds; avoid near-tie comparisons. Questions require at least a 2 cm gap; no confidence intervals were provided in this export.

heightFemale.label: Female height at age 18
heightFemale.source: NCD-RisC (eLife 2016), processed by Our World in Data
heightFemale.definition: Modelled national mean height at age 18 for people born in 1996, separately by sex. These are historical cohort estimates from the 2016 NCD-RisC study, NOT current all-adult height or age19 in2019. OWID export supplies point estimates, not uncertainty bounds; avoid near-tie comparisons. Questions require at least a 2 cm gap; no confidence intervals were provided in this export.

sources.label: French city reference (legacy pack)
sources.definition: INSEE municipal population (city proper), 2023. Ten French cities retained as reference; current worldwide ranking and pin rounds use UN WUP2025 instead.

sources.label: Population history
sources.definition: Annual midyear populations. Growth is (population in 2023 / population in 2000 − 1) × 100. Lines use actual annual observations, indexed to 2000 = 100.

sources.label: Land borders
sources.definition: Land-border lists from the cited open database. Questions use a selected set of targets and avoid China/India and other disputed-border targets. Includes overseas land borders where the database lists them.

sources.label: Base maps
sources.definition: Public-domain simplified Natural Earth country outlines. World pin rounds use an equirectangular world map, UN WUP2025 population-weighted city centroids, and great-circle distance scoring with difficulty-specific tolerances.

citySource.label: Global city population
citySource.definition: Harmonized Degree of Urbanization cities: contiguous densely populated urban centres, not municipal boundaries or commuting-based metro areas. Population-weighted centroid coordinates. Original populations in thousands multiplied by 1000. Threshold 100,000 people in 2025.
citySource.citation: United Nations, Department of Economic and Social Affairs, Population Division (2025). World Urbanization Prospects: The 2025 Revision, Online Edition.

unavailableTopics.reason: The OECD TIME_USE public API responded with 175 aggregate activity records for 35 countries, but contains NO observation-year dimension. OECD metadata explicitly uses different national survey years and methodological caveats; using the latest table as a same-year international comparison would be misleading. No time-use metric was released. Main categories only: leisure, personal care, unpaid work, paid work/study, other; no separately downloadable sleep/eating data obtained.
Direct FAOSTAT FBS (food supply kcal/person/day) and QCL (cattle stocks) API requests timed out during this run. No usable primary observation file acquired; no values fabricated or substituted.
